description: This file contains legacy database access functions for retrieving and inserting 'block' data using an old model, primarily for data migration purposes within the focalboard project.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: A struct representing the SQL storage layer for focalboard, with methods for legacy block data handling.

methods.name: legacyBlocksFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of Block models using the old block structure, for data migration.

methods.name: getLegacyBlock
methods.description: Retrieves a legacy block from the database by workspace and block ID, using the old block model.

methods.name: insertLegacyBlock
methods.description: Inserts or updates a legacy block into the database, maintaining the old data model for migration.
